test.title: Thermal Properties of Matter - Test 2
test.description: Previous Year Questions as Chapter Test
test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text: A uniform cylindrical rod of length <math><mi>L</mi></math> and radius r, is made from a material whose Young’s modulus of Elasticity equals <math><mi>Y</mi><mo>.</mo></math> When this rod is heated by temperature T and simultaneously subjected to a net longutudinal compressional force F, its length remains unchanged. The coefficient of volume expansion, of the material of the rod, is (nearly) equal to:

If the joints of the rod are at 70°C and 20°C in steady and there is no loss of energy from the surface of the rod, the correct relationship between K1, K2 and K3 is :

(Latent heat of fusion of lead $=2.5 \times 10^4 \mathrm{JKg}^{-1}$ and specific heat capacity of lead $=125 \mathrm{JKg}^{-1}$ $\left.\mathrm{K}^{-1}\right)$
